assessments.reasoning: The Haskell 2010 report's Modules chapter matches the hashed public revision. Its opening defines imports as resources brought into scope and explains exports using entities. The export-list section explicitly gives both the permitted sources of explicit exports and the default when a list is omitted.

challenge.method: Challenge the description against a module with no explicit export list and against a module that tries to re-export an imported resource by relying on that default.
challenge.results: An omitted export list exports the described locally defined values, types and classes. Imported entities are excluded from that default. The chapter supplies the general import/export model without requiring every module to enumerate exports.

limitations: This is a description of the Haskell 2010 module model. It does not claim that all modules have written import or export lists.
